title: Magene EXAR Carbon Fiber Wheelset Ultra Series
notes: Official store, USD, tax included. DB508: 50 mm front / 58 mm rear, 23 mm inner and 30 mm outer width, HI-MOD carbon rim and VONOA carbon spokes (21H, 2:1), 36T ratchet, 100/142 mm thru-axle, 1,350 g ±3% without skewers and rim tape. Clincher and tubeless compatible; tires 25c and wider, 28-32c suggested; maximum pressure by tire width (clincher 120 psi at 25c to 90 psi at 32c; tubeless 110 psi at 25c to 80 psi at 32c). The DB508 combination was US$1,199 with the Shimano freehub and US$1,239 with SRAM XDR or Campagnolo N3W. Bead type, rotor mount, load limit and warranty term are not stated on the page. Photo: official product image of the DB508 Ultra rims with the maker's 50 mm/58 mm depth labels.
